changelog:
Initial release of ui-master-static – a full-featured skill for production-grade UI building with native CSS and BEM, without CSS frameworks.

- Provides senior-engineer guidance for CSS architecture: custom property tokens, BEM class naming, organized file structure, and import order.
- Includes stepwise references for layout patterns, modern effects (glassmorphism, gradients, parallax, scroll animations, etc.), and CSS Houdini.
- Emphasizes accessibility and performance, including reduced motion and progressive enhancement for advanced CSS features.
- Designed for projects intentionally avoiding utility CSS frameworks (like Tailwind), with discipline-driven consistency and maintainability.
summary: Use this skill whenever the user wants to build a production-grade UI with native/vanilla CSS — no Tailwind, no CSS-in-JS, no utility framework. Triggers include: plain Vite + HTML/CSS projects, static sites, simple landing pages, or any project explicitly avoiding a CSS framework.
